preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(t), int) for t in [t]) and t >= 1 and t <= 10**4
preconditions.description: The first line of input is a single integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^4) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(n), int) and n >= 1 and n <= 10**5 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: Each subsequent line contains a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5) representing the length of the permutation p for each test case. The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_lines) == t + 1 and (output_lines[0] == '' or output_lines[0] == '\n') for output_lines in [stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: The output consists of exactly t + 1 lines (t test cases + newline), where each test case's output is either a permutation of [0, 1, ..., n-1] or -1.

postconditions.expression: all((all(isinstance(int(x), int) and 0 <= int(x) <= n - 1 for x in line.split()) and len(set(line.split())) == n) or line.strip() == '-1' for line, n in zip(stdout.splitlines()[1:], [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if a permutation exists, the output line contains exactly n distinct integers in the range [0, n-1], each separated by a space. If no permutation exists, the output line is '-1'.

postconditions.expression: all(any(all(int(p[i]) + i == y**2 for i, y in enumerate([int(x) for x in line.split()])) if line.strip() != '-1' else True for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]) for _ in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each test case where the output is not '-1', the permutation p satisfies the condition that for all valid indices i (0 ≤ i ≤ n-1), p[i] + i is a perfect square.
